newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat values steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf grain and soybean markets were quiet Friday and thinly-quoted basis values were nominally unchanged, grain dealers said.
Sri Lanka bought 50,000 tonnes each of Argentine and Australian wheat early Friday, which U.S. dealers said they had expected.

An Egyptian grain official said Friday that Egypt will not tender for wheat this weekend. USDA said it approved Armenia to buy $15 million worth of PL-480 wheat, and expanded India's $15 million in GSM credit to include wheat purchases.
